authoredBy: Riki Taylor — production instructions for the locked Storyboard-02 art direction

scenes.motionPrompt: A young man stands in near-darkness, head lowered toward the device in his hands. He breathes once and his eyes flick down as the screen light catches his face. Behind him, soft city bokeh drifts slowly out of focus and a faint red glow breathes around the device. The camera pushes in slowly and steadily toward his face and hands, never crossing into a close-up. Focus stays locked on his eyes and the near edge of the device; the background stays soft throughout. Lighting is low-key and cold, keyed almost entirely from below by the screen, with a thin warm rim on the left of his jaw. The intended audio event is a single low impact on the first frame, then a rising tension bed. Do not alter, redraw, add or remove any on-screen graphic, notification card, glyph, badge, mark, wordmark, number, date or written element anywhere in frame; every such element is composited afterwards from approved material and must remain exactly as supplied.
scenes.intent: The hook. A fan finding out first, lit only by the device. The notification card itself is composited, never generated.

scenes.motionPrompt: Across the frame, vertical full-height panels each hold a different combat discipline mid-motion: a boxer turning a punch over, a ground exchange, a rising knee, a clinch, a grappling scramble. Each figure moves within its own panel and the panels themselves stay fixed. Sweat and chalk dust catch the light and drift. The camera holds absolutely still. Focus stays even across the full width; no rack, no breathing. Lighting is hard and directional, deep black between the panels, a red key raking each figure from one side. The intended audio event is an accelerating rhythmic impact landing as each panel becomes readable. Do not alter, redraw, add or remove any headline, caption, lettering, numeral, mark or wordmark anywhere in frame, and do not change the panel divisions or their widths; all typography is composited afterwards from approved copy.
scenes.intent: Breadth. Every combat sport, one place. The panel geometry is locked art direction and the model may not reflow it.

scenes.motionPrompt: Deterministic only. The approved frame is separated into depth layers and given a controlled parallax push, with a restrained scroll on the product panel. This scene is never submitted to a generation provider.
scenes.intent: Event discovery. The real Combat Reviews events screen must stay exactly as captured, so nothing about this scene is generated.

scenes.motionPrompt: Deterministic only. A restrained tilt and push on the approved frame, with the ordered rows revealing in sequence so the movement reads as research rather than decoration. This scene is never submitted to a generation provider.
scenes.intent: Rankings research. Every row carries a real fighter and a real record; a generative model would invent both.

scenes.motionPrompt: Two athletes face each other from opposite edges of frame, each holding their stance and breathing hard. Their shoulders settle and each leans a fraction toward the other; heads stay level and neither crosses the centre. Haze drifts through the beam between them. The camera pushes in a very small amount and stops. Focus holds both figures; the centre of frame stays clear and unobstructed for the card that will be composited there. Lighting is hard top-back key, deep shadow, a red edge on the left figure and a cool edge on the right. The intended audio event is a low tension bed with a soft data texture underneath. Do not alter, redraw, add or remove the centre comparison card or any name, numeral, record, rank, marker, badge, mark or written element anywhere in frame, and do not move either figure into the centre; all of that is composited afterwards from approved material.
scenes.intent: The face-off. The centre of frame is deliberately protected so the comparison card lands on clean plate.

scenes.motionPrompt: Deterministic only. The selection state animates on the approved frame: the reaching hand arrives, the chosen card lifts and the control depresses, synchronised. This scene is never submitted to a generation provider.
scenes.intent: The free prediction. The interface state is the product claim, so it is animated deterministically and never regenerated.

scenes.motionPrompt: A struck bell swings hard at the top of frame and rings out, its surface flaring where the light catches it. Below, two athletes break toward each other and an official steps back out of the way. Haze and dust punch outward from the movement. The camera holds still and takes a single sharp jolt on the strike, then settles. Focus stays on the bell for the strike and holds; the figures below stay slightly soft. Lighting is hard, high-contrast and arena-lit, with a deep red wash flooding the frame on impact and falling away. The intended audio event is a fight bell and a confirmation hit, with the music bed dropping under it. Do not alter, redraw, add or remove any confirmation pill, caption, lettering, numeral, tick, mark or wordmark anywhere in frame; every such element is composited afterwards from approved material.
scenes.intent: The submission beat. A hard audiovisual impact that earns the confirmation, which is composited rather than generated.

scenes.motionPrompt: At the left of frame an athlete raises both arms and holds the pose, chest heaving, head tipping back. Behind, a dark crowd lifts and light flares sweep across them; fine particles drift upward through the beam. The right of frame stays clear and unobstructed. The camera drifts very slightly, handheld, without settling into a move. Focus stays on the celebrating figure; the crowd behind stays soft. Lighting is hard backlight through haze, deep black foreground, a red key from frame left. The intended audio event is a crowd lift and a confirmation hit. Do not alter, redraw, add or remove the result panel at the right of frame or any tick, label, rank, numeral, badge, mark or written element anywhere in frame, and do not move the celebrating figure across the centre; all of that is composited afterwards from approved material.
scenes.intent: The reward. The right of frame is protected plate for the result panel that is composited over it.

postMotion.preservedRegion: the right-side space the predictor-rank interface occupies
prohibitions: must not crop or obscure the predictor-rank interface region
postMotion.rationale: The authored move is a restrained handheld drift, which ltx-hosted has no value for. The provider is asked for a locked-off frame and the drift is applied deterministically, so the intention survives without asking a model for a move it cannot make.

scenes.motionPrompt: Two people at the left of frame lean over a shared device, reacting to something on it: one laughs and turns to the other, who shakes their head and points. Their movement is small and natural, not performed. Behind them a dim room stays still. The right of frame stays clear and unobstructed. The camera drifts a fraction, handheld, and does not settle. Focus stays on the two faces; the background falls away softly. Lighting is warm and low, keyed from the shared device below with a cool ambient fill behind. The intended audio event is room texture, muted crowd and light activity underneath. Do not alter, redraw, add or remove the panel at the right of frame or any comment, thread, tab, count, avatar, handle, numeral, mark or written element anywhere in frame; every such element is composited afterwards from approved material.
scenes.intent: The community beat. Real human reaction on the left; the product panel is composited on protected plate at the right.

postMotion.preservedRegion: the phone geometry and the discussion-interface region

must not crop or obscure the discussion-interface region
postMotion.rationale: The authored move is a restrained handheld drift, which ltx-hosted has no value for. The provider is asked for a locked-off frame and a one percent lateral drift is applied deterministically, preserving the phone's geometry.

scenes.motionPrompt: Deterministic only. Restrained motion and a clean hold: the composition settles and stays stable and readable to the last frame. This scene is never submitted to a generation provider.
scenes.intent: The brand and call-to-action frame. Every element on it is approved typography and owned brand material, so nothing here is generated.
